ns2:section.sectionText: This course will be taught via Moodle in combination with Zoom. "Slavic Folklore." Here's a description: This course covers major genres of folk songs and prose connected to calendar and life rituals, folk beliefs, and entertainment in Slavic cultures, along with significant analytical and theoretical approaches to their study. Students will read folkloric texts in the original for Slavic languages they know and in translation for others.
